name: radare2
description_en: UNIX-like reverse engineering framework and command-line toolset
readme_excerpt: Radare2: Libre Reversing Framework for Unix Geeks Current git master branch is 6.2.3, next release will be 6.2.4. Description r2 is a complete rewrite of radare. It provides a set of libraries, tools and plugins to ease reverse engineering tasks. Distributed under LGPLv3, despite each plugin can have different licenses (see r2 -Lj for details) The radare project started as a simple command-line hexadecimal editor focused on forensics.
